observations.interpretation: The observed Circle smart-account authorization independently validated under EIP-1271 but was rejected before settlement by a payment path requiring ordinary recovery to the from address. This is not a fulfilment failure and does not establish universal smart-account incompatibility.

pricing_observation.note: The service publishes dynamic pricing. The second fresh quote was 1391 atomic USDC; actual settlement later decayed to 1371 within the authorised maximum. Price alone is not treated as service-contract drift.

receipt_limitations.operator_attestation_note: Observed authorization objects contained an empty attestation_sig, so seller-wallet delegation to the receipt signer was not independently cryptographically established.
receipt_limitations.hash_serialization_note: Input/output binding was independently reproduced using compact JSON; the public metadata does not fully specify canonical JSON serialization and output field order affected the reproduced output hash.

limitations: LEI validation was structure and checksum only; no registry-existence lookup was performed.
The two successful paid controls are timestamped observations, not proof of permanent reliability.
The Circle finding is specific to the observed smart-account path and is not universal smart-account incompatibility.
The Circle-created signature is not classified as invalid; independent EIP-1271 validation succeeded.
The Circle path did not settle, so no paid fulfilment was reached and it is not counted as a failed fulfilment.
The malformed 19-character fixture prepared during planning was not exercised on the paid path.
The empty operator attestation signature prevents independent cryptographic verification of seller-wallet delegation to the XDR-1 receipt signer.
conclusion: Two bounded EOA purchases settled on Base and returned the independently expected positive and negative LEI checksum results. Both paid XDR-1 receipt signatures and exact input/output binding were independently verified. A separate Circle smart-account authorization independently validated under EIP-1271 but was rejected by the observed code402 payment path before settlement.
